default.description: What the island window may call: events, one entry per backend plugin, settings (read, and write for plugins that remember choices).

overlay.description: The capture overlay: read the capture, copy or save the annotated image, hide itself.

popup.description: The shortcut popup: read settings and clipboard history, copy, paste, hide itself.

settings.description: The settings window: read and write settings, and toggle launch at login.
